lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are organized in vertical columns of 3 to 4 spots across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal spot alignments, creating a lattice pattern where high-luminance nodes are centered within the vertical stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient showing light on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal organisms (remoras) are visible in close proximity to the ventral surface and trailing the pectoral fin.
